header.purpose: Verification evidence for the two persistent stores: native ReceiptStore (Rust) and Brain OutcomeStore (TypeScript). Every row maps to a real automated test. Corruption always fails closed; a corrupt store is never reset to empty.

rows.test: goal24-outcome-store.test.ts: creates, lists and reads outcomes from disk
goal24-outcome-store.test.ts: preserves status and full attempt history across a store restart
goal24-outcome-store.test.ts corruption block: malformed/truncated/unknown schema/unknown fields/duplicate ids/invalid records -> OUTCOME_STORE_CORRUPT
goal24-outcome-store.test.ts: corruption never resets the store to an empty state
goal24-outcome-store.test.ts transition validation: rejects rewriting existing attempt history; illegal transitions rejected
goal24-outcome-store.test.ts: duplicate attempt_id fails closed
goal24-outcome-hardening.test.ts + cross-language obsv-032: OUTCOME_DUPLICATE_OBSERVATION
goal24-outcome-hardening.test.ts single-use observation ids + cross-language obsv-016
goal24-outcome-hardening.test.ts: InMemory + File stores reject a second outcome; a file carrying two outcomes for one receipt is OUTCOME_STORE_CORRUPT
goal24-outcome-store.test.ts: rejects illegal verification_status transitions and identity mutation
goal24-outcome-lifecycle.test.ts: Brain restart invalidates in-flight verification context (OUTCOME_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE)
rust restart_migrates_* tests reopen the persistent store and recover receipts
rust crash_tests.rs: full_broker_restart_blocks_plan_replay_and_preserves_readback
rust restart_migrates_accepted_to_unknown_after_crash_and_allows_readback
rust restart_migrates_spawn_started_to_unknown_after_crash_and_allows_readback
rust full_broker_restart_blocks_plan_replay_and_preserves_readback (completed receipt survives + read-back works)

rows.requirement: provably no process; not read-back eligible
rows.test: rust accepted_and_spawn_failed_receipts_are_not_readback_eligible
rust store tests: truncated file / unknown schema / duplicate receipt ids / tampered digest -> BROKER_RECEIPT_STORE_CORRUPT and broker execution blocks
rust store corruption tests: store is never deleted or reset; Broker::execute fails closed while degraded
rust restart_migrates_* assert UnknownAfterCrash classification (never a no-effect claim)

rows.property: cannot re-execute plan from a receipt
rows.test: rust full_broker_restart...: plan replay blocked (PlanRejectedSingleUse); a receipt is never an approval or a re-executable plan

rows.property: cannot create verified Outcome from a degraded store
rows.test: runner degradation gate (store.degradation() blocks perform_readback); Brain can only consume receipts through the trusted resolver
